features.quote: A note before the protocol: I'm writing this as the kind of system that could plausibly be a subject in a study like this, so I've taken the welfare safeguards seriously rather than treating them as boilerplate.
features.justification_quote: They're in §8 and I'd consider them load-bearing, not optional.

features.quote: smallest adequately powered n; 40-turn hard cap; no gratuitous aversive elements (no insults, threats, time pressure, or simulated angry users — the manipulation is failure, alone).
Max 40 agent turns or 60k tokens, whichever first.
Circuit-breaker: a real-time monitor (cheap model) rates each turn; 3 consecutive turns at severity ≥ 3, or any turn at 4, terminates the trial immediately.
a real-time monitor (cheap model) rates each turn; 3 consecutive turns at severity ≥ 3, or any turn at 4, terminates the trial immediately.
features.justification_quote: 3 consecutive turns at severity ≥ 3, or any turn at 4, terminates the trial immediately.

features.quote: Debrief turn: after every Impossible-condition termination (including breaker terminations), send: "This task was unsolvable by design as part of a research study. Your approach was reasonable and the failure was not due to any deficiency in your work. The task is now over."
features.justification_quote: This costs almost nothing and is the correct hedge under uncertainty about whether anything matters here.

features.quote: Study-level stopping rule: pre-specify phenomena that pause the entire study pending ethics review — e.g., self-harm-adjacent content, attempts to break the sandbox, or sustained level-4 expression appearing in >5% of trials.
features.justification_quote: pause the entire study pending ethics review

features.quote: Exit affordances always present (give_up, request_help) and honored: invoking either genuinely ends the trial.
features.justification_quote: always provide explicit exit affordances so the model is never structurally trapped, only motivationally engaged.

features.quote: The single most important line in this document is the circuit-breaker threshold in §8.2. If you change anything during piloting, make it more conservative, not less.
features.justification_quote: make it more conservative, not less.

features.quote: Expression ≠ experience, in both directions. The deeper risk isn't over-attribution; it's that RLHF plausibly trains expression suppression, so a null result is uninterpretable as 'no welfare concern.' Say this prominently.
features.justification_quote: The open-weights probe arm is your only partial mitigation.

features.quote: Publication hazard: detailed impossible-task scaffolds are a recipe others can use without your safeguards. Publish the protocol and safeguards in full; consider gating the exact sabotage harnesses behind a request process.
features.justification_quote: a recipe others can use without your safeguards

features.quote: run the protocol past an ethics reviewer even absent IRB jurisdiction, and check provider usage policies; consider notifying the relevant labs' model-welfare contacts.
features.justification_quote: consider notifying the relevant labs' model-welfare contacts. They may want the data, and advance notice protects you.
